title: DiTAR+: Dual Optimization for Robust Autoregressive Diffusion Speech Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2609.13909v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous-latent Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer (AR-DiT) models have demonstrated immense potential in zero-shot speech generation. However, they still suffer from limited decoding stability when synthesizing long utterances or complex linguistic structures. This instability primarily stems from a restricted historical receptive field and an acoustic inertia dependency within the diffusion decoder, which causes the model to ignore semantic conditions. To address these challenges, we propose DiTAR+, a dual-optimization framework. First, we introduce Dilated Context Sampling to expand the macro-level historical receptive field without violating physical temporal continuity, thereby preventing cumulative error propagation. Second, we propose Hierarchical Acoustic Masking to prevent shallow layers from attending to acoustic pre-context, explicitly decoupling semantic alignment from acoustic detail reconstruction. translated_title: DiTAR+：面向鲁棒自回归扩散语音合成的双重优化
translated_abstract: 连续潜变量自回归扩散Transformer（AR-DiT）模型在零样本语音生成中展现出巨大潜力。然而，在合成长语句或复杂语言结构时，这类模型仍面临解码稳定性有限的问题。这种不稳定性主要源于受限的历史感受野以及扩散解码器内部的声学惯性依赖，导致模型忽略语义条件。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了DiTAR+，一个双重优化框架。首先，我们引入扩张上下文采样，在不违反物理时间连续性的前提下扩展宏观层面的历史感受野，从而防止累积误差的传播。其次，我们提出分层声学掩码机制，防止浅层网络关注声学前置上下文，显式地将语义对齐与声学细节重建解耦。大量实验证明了该方法的有效性。
tldr: DiTAR+提出双重优化框架，通过扩张上下文采样扩展历史感受野、分层声学掩码解耦语义与声学建模，解决了AR-DiT模型在长语句合成中的解码不稳定问题。
en_tdlr: DiTAR+ proposes a dual-optimization framework combining Dilated Context Sampling and Hierarchical Acoustic Masking to resolve decoding instability in AR-DiT models for robust zero-shot speech synthesis.
